name: Steel Nutz Metal Fabrication
old_description: At Steel Nutz Metal Fabrication, we are passionate about delivering high-quality custom metal fabrication solutions built to meet your exact needs. With extensive experience in custom fabrication, we specialize in custom off-road fabrication for all your off-road desert toys, creating durable, precision-built components designed to perform in the toughest conditions. We also design and fabricate custom trailers tailored to your specific hauling and recreational needs. Every project is completed with expert craftsmanship, attention to detail, and a commitment to quality, ensuring long-lasting results you can rely on. Whether you're upgrading your off-road vehicle, building a one-of-a-kind trailer, or need custom metal fabrication, Steel Nutz Metal Fabrication is dedicated to bringing your vision to life with precision, durability, and exceptional service.
about:
Steel Nutz Metal Fabrication operates from Murrieta, California. The shop is owned by Mike, who is referenced in customer testimonials as the owner. The founding year is not publicly disclosed.

The shop provides custom welding and fabrication services across six core areas: commercial fabrication, off-road vehicle components, custom trailers, suspension upgrades, work trucks, and exhaust systems. Projects range from small parts to large structures such as a two-story steel bunker, with work performed on materials including steel and aluminum. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are published.

Customers include contractors, homeowners, business owners, and off-road enthusiasts. Testimonials cite work on a Toyota 4Runner (ARB lockers, skid plate, bumper), a sand car (suspension inspection, shock rebuild, fuel system), a Chinese buggy (cage reinforcement), and watercraft welding repairs. The shop also serves commercial trailer needs for contractors.

The company emphasizes being insured and offering free quotes. Its stated focus is on expert craftsmanship, attention to detail, and a commitment to quality, aiming to deliver durable, precision-built solutions tailored to each project.
